title: Query count in a recursive NAND block
statement: Let $d$ be a nonnegative integer, let $i\\in\\{0,1\\}$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree on sign inputs with $2^d$ coordinates. Embed those coordinates as block $i$ among the $2^{d+1}$ coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign assignment on the larger cube. The number of queries made by the reindexed tree on $x$ equals the number made by $T$ on the restriction of $x$ to block $i$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a finite sign-valued decision tree on 2^d coordinates
x is a sign assignment on 2^(d+1) coordinates
